versions.changelog: Composio para buscar (Tavily y Apify) con comandos exactos en f100k-puente, actores con virgulilla y reglas de evidencia

Initial release of radar-contenido-f100k for FÓRMULA 100K–style Instagram format tracking.

- Monitors Instagram, harvesting trending formats via Apify (hashtag searches + follower analysis) and user-submitted Reels (via Telegram).
- Filters for small accounts whose reels significantly outperform their follower count (vistas ÷ seguidores).
- Requires visual review: only formats with observed step-by-step mechanics are logged. Caption alone never counts.
- Detects when a format crosses niches (recurs in 2+ unrelated areas).
- No logins, reposts, nor topic/viral/news detection—focus is on format structure, not content.
- Runs on OpenClaw agent (not on Claude Code); integrates with Telegram for reporting and reel submission.
- Provides clear, step-by-step setup and operational guidelines in Spanish.
